items.title: AWS Cannot Restore Data Held Only in Damaged Middle East Availability Zones
items.summary: AWS has told customers it cannot restore resources and data hosted exclusively in the mec1-az2 availability zone in the UAE, or exclusively in the Bahrain region, after damage during the conflict with Iran. The company says the Bahrain damage spanned multiple availability zones and exceeded what its regional and multi-AZ services are designed to withstand. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: Kubernetes 1.37 Released: Stable Metrics API  and Rootless Kubelet in Beta
items.summary: The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) announced the release of Kubernetes 1.37, named "Garhwal", emphasizing its focus on stability, security, and AI/ML workload optimization. By Mostafa Radwan

items.title: Bun Rewrites 535K Lines of Zig into Rust in Four Months, Eliminates Numerous Memory Leaks
items.summary: Bun creator Jarred Sumner recently announced that Bun, the JavaScript/TypeScript runtime, bundler and package manager has been rewritten from Zig to Rust. The rewrite seeks to eliminate recurrent memory safety vulnerabilities via Rust’s borrow checker. The AI-assisted rewrite was released after 4 months of work instead of the estimated one year. By Bruno Couriol

items.title: Russlands  „Super-App“ Max: Überwachung vorbei am Smartphone-OS
items.summary: Eine Studie legt das Ausmaß der Spionagefähigkeiten der russischen Super-App Max offen. Die staatlich verordnete Anwendung gilt als Muster digitaler Kontrolle.

items.title: Enterprise-Schwenk: Portainer friert Community Edition ein
